event_description: Siliguri (West Bengal), Aug 19 (IBNS) Sikkim and parts of West Bengal's Darjeeling state were cut off from the rest of the country on Thursday, the second time this week, after massive landslides washed away a major portion of road at Likhuvir on 31A National Highway near Teesta Bazar, official sources said.  The landslides, triggered by heavy rains, washed a good chunk of surface at Likhuvir forcing the authorities to close roads for all vehicles for indefinite period, according to BRO, which maintains the strategic roads linking landlocked Sikkim.
